title: Post-approval / bulk-reject leaderboard refetch is silently dropped when reached from a cold-booted ApplicationDetail (tag never set for that route)
detail: UserConfirmedApproval (and ApiReturnedBulkReject at 5019/5025, plus the demo arm at demo_update.gleam:325) dispatch ApiReturnedLeaderboard without setting leaderboard_vacancy_id. Session restore (1114) and enter_demo (5925) only tag VacancyDetail/Handoff, so a cold boot to /vacancies/:vid/applications/:aid leaves the tag None; the guard `Ok(response), Some(current) if current == vacancy_id` then falls through to `_, _ -> #(model, effect.none())` and the refresh the sweep-nudge comment depends on is discarded. Self-heals on next vacancy-detail navigation, so no wrong data is shown.
recommended_fix: Set leaderboard_vacancy_id: Some(vid) alongside these refetches (or tag ApplicationDetail cold-boot routes) so the response the fetch was dispatched for is accepted.
